body.purpose: Chat bubbles and descriptive card text.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default card/panel shadow, warm-black tint independent of accent hue.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Paired with translateY(-3px) card lift on hover.

shadows.name: inset-highlight
shadows.purpose: One-pixel top-edge catch-light simulating an overhead light source.

shadows.name: cobalt-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover glow — the only shadow allowed to carry the accent hue.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Default tactile hover/press easing for cards, buttons, chips, toggles.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Staggered slideUp entrance for welcome screen and messages.

components.name: Primary Button (Send)
components.description: Circular cobalt send button in the composer.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-send" aria-label="Send message"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M4 12L20 4L13 20L11 13L4 12Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-send { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #5b8fff; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 350ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 350ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(91,143,255,0); } .ds-btn-send:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.06); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(91,143,255,0.45); } .ds-btn-send:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b8fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card-shell { background: #161714; border-radius: 20px; padding: 6px; box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(10,8,2,0.45); } .ds-card-core { background: #161714; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); transition: border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-card-shell:hover .ds-card-core { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-card-header { padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.6rem; font-family: 'Clash Display', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #f0ede6; } .ds-card-body { padding: 0 1rem 0.9rem; font-size: 14px; color: #9e9b93; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Ghost Toggle Button
components.description: Compact toggle used for people/night counters and mode switches (rpb/hnb/dmb/wut).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: transparent; color: #9e9b93; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1e1f1c; color: #f0ede6; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-btn-ghost--active { background: #5b8fff; color: #fff; border-color: #5b8fff; }

components.name: Agent Status Dot
components.description: Signature component: small colored dot showing per-agent state (idle/running/done).
components.css: .ds-agent-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8a877f; display: inline-block; } .ds-agent-dot--running { background: #5b8fff; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(91,143,255,0.5); animation: ds-pulse 1.2s infinite; } .ds-agent-dot--done { background: #8fa87a; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

narrative.northStar: Waypoint is a globe coming alive under your fingertips — every AI decision is a route drawn in real time, not a line of text.
narrative.overview: Waypoint AI is not a form that outputs a PDF itinerary; it's a flight deck. The user sits in a near-black cockpit (#0e0f0e) lit by a single cobalt instrument glow, watching four specialist agents work in parallel — each decision (a hotel, a stop, a route) resolving into a precise, tactile readout rather than a wall of prose. The globe on the splash screen isn't decoration; it's the thesis statement, rendered literally. Every card in the app after that point is a smaller echo of the same idea: information with weight, motion with intent, one color that means "this is live." This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard: no gradient-clip hero-metric tiles, no identical icon+heading card grids, no boilerplate uppercase eyebrow tags stacked above every section, no side-stripe accent borders, no decorative glassmorphism. The floating nav's backdrop-blur is the one deliberate exception — functional (fixed/sticky), not decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first OLED canvas with a warm off-white ink, not pure white-on-black
A single cobalt accent carries all 'this is interactive / this is live' meaning; four muted secondary hues exist only for semantic tagging
Clash Display for anything that names or labels; Switzer for anything read at length
Spring-decelerated motion (cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)) on every tactile interaction
Double-bezel card architecture: a quiet outer shell around the primary content surface

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears only where something is interactive or currently true. It never appears as a passive decorative wash across a whole section.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds and text are never pure black/white. Ink Black carries a green undertone; Paper carries a warm cream undertone.

rules.name: The No-Italic Rule
rules.body: Clash Display ships no italic face. Emphasis within display type is weight + cobalt color, never a synthesized skew-italic.

rules.name: The Concentric Radius Rule
rules.body: Any nested shell's inner radius = outer radius minus padding, so the curves stay visually concentric.

dos: Do keep cobalt as the only color that signals interactivity or 'currently true'.
Do use the spring ease cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) for every tactile hover/press interaction.
Do pair a resting shadow + 1px inset top highlight on every card, brightening to a hover shadow + lift on interaction.
Do keep Ink Black and Paper warm-tinted, never pure #000/#fff.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: cut entrance choreography entirely, keep functional feedback.
Do gate hover-only affordances behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS dashboard: no gradient-clip hero-metric tiles, no identical icon+heading card grids, no uppercase eyebrow kickers, no side-stripe accent borders.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — backdrop-blur is reserved for the fixed/sticky nav island only.
Don't synthesize a fake italic for Clash Display.
Don't let a secondary accent leak into a role cobalt owns.
Don't animate top/left/width/height — transform and opacity only.
Don't start scale-based entrance animations from scale(0).
